The fix preserves all existing behavior for normal hosts and correctly falls back to on_error for unavailable classifiers, which was the intended behavior all along (the bug bypassed it).

evidence.manual_release_testing: None required — this is an internal refactor of ModelManager::build_cache() and validate_collection_request() with no user-visible behavior change, no API change, no CLI/GUI changes, and no shipped artifact changes.
evidence.post_approval_commits: First approval was 2026-08-30T19:31:42Z (fl0rianr). Two commits were added after that: a merge of main (dc044af) and the final 'share one component resolver' commit (4bc3455). The final commit directly addressed SlawomirNowaczyk's CHANGES_REQUESTED concern about unifying the resolvers; SlawomirNowaczyk re-approved on 2026-09-06. No commits were added after the latest approval. The merge is routine. The final commit remains within the spirit and scope of the fix.
evidence.review: PR #3414 received substantive review from @fl0rianr (smart-router maintainer) and @SlawomirNowaczyk (smart-router maintainer). fl0rianr opened three rounds of inline-adjacent comments identifying specific edge cases (post-filter bare-name aliases only, missing full precedence, missing builtin.<X> and input_aliases paths), then approved once all were resolved. evidence.tests: Three regression tests added to test_model_manager_collection_validation.cpp, each covering a different alias-form path (bare-name, canonical-in-components-bare-name-on-classifier, builtin.<X>). shout_outs.reason: Identified three distinct edge cases across iterative reviews — post-filter bare-name aliases only, missing full alias precedence, and missing builtin.<X> + input_aliases paths — each of which caused Bekhouche to progressively extract a shared alias-algorithm function that eliminated the drift the original bug relied on.

Caught the root-cause asymmetry between two hand-written component resolvers that could silently diverge, then provided a concrete architectural suggestion to extract shared resolution logic; approved only after the PR unified the resolver into one function with distinct tiers.

subject: fix(routing): don't drop the whole router policy over one hardware-filtered classifier (#3414)
summary: Fixes a bug where a single hardware-filtered classifier (e.g. an NPU-backed model on a host without an NPU) caused the entire router policy to be silently dropped, by snapshotting model type and alias information before the hardware filter and using those pre-filter snapshots in the routing-policy resolver.
verdict_reason: A well-structured, iteratively reviewed fix that eliminates a real routing-policy drop bug, includes regression tests for multiple alias-form edge cases, and unifies previously duplicated resolver logic to prevent future drift.
